title: Training for sustainable scientific software in the AI era: from code production to scientific stewardship
abstract: arXiv:2611.23330v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative and agentic artificial intelligence (AI) systems are changing how researchers interact with scientific software. Their effects on productivity vary across tasks and users, but they can weaken the connection between producing a successful computational artifact and retaining scientific command over the consequential choices and evidence on which it depends. For high-energy physics, this shifts part of the training challenge from code production toward scientific stewardship: researchers must be able to validate, explain, reproduce, maintain, and justify software and workflows partly generated or modified by AI. We argue that AI-aware software training should therefore combine dedicated instruction on AI systems with the integration of AI into established software and analysis training. Testing, provenance, reproducibility, resource judgment, and scientific validation should be exercised in AI-assisted workflows, with competence

translated_title: AI时代的可持续科学软件培训：从代码生产到科学管护
translated_abstract: 生成式和智能体式人工智能（AI）系统正在改变研究人员与科学软件交互的方式。它们对生产力的影响因任务和用户而异，但可能会削弱“成功产出计算成果”与“对其所依赖的关键选择和证据保持科学掌控”之间的联系。对于高能物理领域而言，这使得部分培训挑战从代码生产转向科学管护：研究人员必须能够验证、解释、复现、维护并论证部分由AI生成或修改的软件和工作流程。我们认为，具有AI意识的软件培训应当将对AI系统的专门教学与将AI融入既有的软件和分析培训相结合。测试、溯源、可复现性、资源判断和科学验证应在AI辅助的工作流程中得到训练和实践，使研究人员具备相应的能力……
tldr: 该论文提出在AI时代，科学软件培训应从代码生产转向科学管护，通过将AI系统教学与既有软件和分析培训相融合，使研究人员能够在AI辅助的工作流程中具备验证、解释、复现和维护科学软件的能力。
